note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Scenario A shows the initial relation as supplied (Party C's card stays in her tray); scenario B shows the intervention requested as supplied (her card in the third slot). Both are supplied configurations of equal weight; the request is never shown as granted or refused; no winner, rule, standing test, effect or outcome.
